description: A real, one-time gas-seed USDC transfer (defaultSeedChild, REQ-204's edge case, wired between step 5/deploy and step 6/registerIdentity) is sent from the driving citizen's own wallet to the freshly-generated child EVM address BEFORE the identity anchor is complete. If ANY subsequent step in the SAME attempt fails -- registerIdentity (step 6), mcp.json write (step 7), buildChildSpec's own distinct-wallet assertion (step 8), or the final ledger/registry append (step 9) -- the attempt is recorded as status:"failed" (correctly, per CRIT-203/PROP-307c) and the child is never added to citizens.json. On the colony's NEXT eligible spawn attempt, child-spec.js::nextChildId (monotonic max+1) always mints a BRAND NEW child_id and spawn-orchestrator.mjs's step 2 always generates a BRAND NEW EVM wallet -- the previously-seeded child address/wallet is never reused, revisited, or referenced again anywhere in the codebase. The already-transferred gas seed (ANICCA_SEED_USDC, default $1 per skills/self/spawn/lib/spawn-orchestrator.mjs:56) is therefore permanently stranded in an abandoned wallet: its private key is persisted to disk (~/.anicca-children/<childId>/.automaton/wallet.json, mode 0600) but no running process, citizen, or automated mechanism ever reads that specific home directory again, since the child never became a live citizen. This is a genuine, real-money leak on every post-seed failure, distinct from CRIT-203's scope (which only requires the ledger to correctly RECORD the failure, which it does) -- CRIT-203/REQ-307's own Edge Cases text never mentions fund recovery or reuse for this scenario. Exposure is bounded but not eliminated: decideColonySpawn's failureCooldownCap=3 (treasury-gate.mjs) halts further spawn attempts after 3 failures within the 14-day cooldown window, capping the leak at roughly 3x ANICCA_SEED_USDC per cooldown cycle rather than being unbounded. No test in spawn-orchestrator.test.mjs or spawn-orchestrator-gas-seed-and-key-persistence.test.mjs asserts anything about fund recovery/reuse across attempts (they only test each attempt in isolation).

evidence.snippet: const childId = nextChildId(readChildren(ledgerFile), "anicca-c"); ... const seedStep = await runStep({... run: () => deps.seedChild ? ... : defaultSeedChild(...) ...}); ... const identityStep = await runStep({... run: () => deps.registerIdentity ? ... : defaultRegisterIdentity(...) ...}); if (identityStep.failed) return { status: "failed", childId, error: identityStep.error };
evidence.testName: confirmed by code read, not currently exercised by any delivered test: PROP-307c step 6 test (spawn-orchestrator.test.mjs) injects a registerIdentity failure via deps override (seedChild never actually runs against a real/fixture money-moving path in that test), so the cross-attempt fund-stranding consequence is never observed by the existing suite.
